events.title: Leafborn gameplay
events.summary: We’re streaming Leafborn gameplay live on loop.In Leafborn you control a character made of thousands of leaves. Shift forms, turn into a tornado, smash like a hammer. Every skill works differently in every form. Parkour across floating islands and stop the Nulls, the robots stealing your world’s energy.Every run is different and you build your own loadout.If you like what you see, adding Leafborn to your wishlist helps a lot. events.title: Leafborn Is Growing: New Team, New Look, New Features!
events.summary: Hi everyone!Leafborn is now being developed by a team of three. While I continue working on the technical side, two artists are helping shape the game’s characters, environments, and overall visual style.Leafborn is becoming more stylized, vibrant, and unique. You can see some of our latest work below.You can support Leafborn on Patreon to access exclusive content, special Discord roles and channels, and future early playtests.Thank you for supporting us!Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/Leafb
